name: lem-maincb-stage2-raw-extension
source: imports validated registry lemma proofs/lem-maincb-stage2-raw-extension — After first fixing the universal C_s2^0,e_s2^0 witnesses of lem-maincb-stage2-extcb-datum, C_ext,e_ext witnesses of conj-extcb, and C_iso_unit,e_iso_unit witnesses of lem-maincb-isomorphism-unit-control, there are universal D_2 < infinity and e_2 > 0 such that for every def-maincb-witness-ledger datum W with W.e_s2 <= min{e_s2^0,e_2}, C_s2^0*e_2 <= e_ext, and (C_ext+1)*C_s2^0*e_2 <= e_iso_unit, every explicit Stage-2 raw-call closed EXT-CB datum in A_R with total post-helper defect at most C_s2^0*t and 0 <= t <= W.e_s2 admits an extended D_2*t-isomorphism v_+:M_{r+1}->A_R satisfying ||v_+(I_{M_{r+1}})-u_{A_R}|| <= D_2*t.
